text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I'm very sorry! I spaced out for a
second
there...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Um... That was a remarkable race! Truly

breathtaking!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It's a bizarre feeling...
I know the race is
over, but
it's like... I want to see the rest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But now it's settled. We know who the
greatest
is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a little while, Reporter Otonashi
gazes
vacantly at the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The greatest has actually been
decided... The
reality of the situation is
slowly starting to sink in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...That was a fantastic race. Everyone
truly gave it
their all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As someone who has supported the two
of you all
this time, I feel... frustrated?
...Saddened?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: But... We now know who the greatest is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporter Otonashi gazes vacantly at the
track. Her mind seems to be elsewhere,
but I need to go
check on how my
partner is doing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The title of "greatest" has been decided.
But our
journey is still far from over!
